rationale.provenance-auditability: Persistent metadata records AI origin, source models, timestamps, and modifications.
rationale.risk-routing: Detected AI segments are explicitly selected for targeted human review.
rationale.rules-based-checks: Hybrid hard rules and adapted SCA ground code checks.
rationale.oversight-explanation: IDE labels and origin metadata help developers judge generated code.
rationale.org-governance: Recommends lifecycle policies, controls, education, roles, and audit processes.
rationale.regulatory-compliance: Centers EU AI Act, GDPR disclosure, audits, and licensing obligations.
rationale.quality-debt: Synthesizes maintenance, documentation, debugging, and technical-debt harms.
rationale.lit-review: Paper synthesizes prior studies, industry data, and case evidence.
rationale.assistive: Copilot-style human-initiated code generation is a central setting.
rationale.agentic: Autonomous open-ended coding agents receive dedicated safety analysis.
rationale.risk-security: Focally synthesizes vulnerabilities and targeted security assessment.
rationale.risk-quality: Focally analyzes maintainability, debugging, documentation, and technical debt.
rationale.risk-overreliance: Analyzes over-reliance and developer skill erosion as operational harms.
rationale.risk-ip: Focally analyzes ownership, copyright, licensing, and infringement.
rationale.risk-bias: Focally analyzes discriminatory behavior arising from generated code.
